body:
### Summary

I created a folder named **Python** and wanted to initialize uv within, which failed.

# Reproduce

```bash
> mkdir Python
> cd Python
> uv init --python 3.13
error: failed to install: python-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl (python==0.1.0). Caused by: Scripts must not use the reserved name 'python', got: 'python'
```

# Explanation

It fails, because uv takes the parent folder name converted to lower case as a new project name, which clashes with the reserved 'python' name. However, the error message is not very clear about that mistake and other files are still generated in that folder. 

# Solution

- improve error message so that the user understands that renaming the parent folder is a simple fix
- fail earlier before any other init files are created in the folder


### Platform

Win 11

### Version

latest

### Python version

3.13
title: Fails to init when parent folder name is "python"
